title: CDC reports advice to keep breastfeeding going until age two or older
summary: CDC's 31 July 2026 breastfeeding page puts the longer duration at 2 years of age or older, with other foods alongside the milk.
body: Past the early months, the duration on CDC's 31 July 2026 breastfeeding page runs until a child is 2 years old or older. The page ties that span to the Dietary Guidelines for Americans, the American Academy of Pediatrics, and the World Health Organization. Other foods enter around the middle of the first year and sit beside the milk rather than replacing it. This card is only that longer span. It is not the six-month exclusive period, and a household may not match the printed duration.

sources.title: Breastfeeding Fast Facts
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: US CDC page. Public domain. Paraphrased. Supports continued breastfeeding until 2 years or older, with complementary foods around 6 months.
